title: Making the call is making progress
coreMove: A decision is progress, not its setup: it turns doubt into movement and produces the next evidence, so choose at the smallest responsible scale instead of waiting for certainty.

exampleSpecs.audience: team leads watching open questions pile up
exampleSpecs.stakes: keep saying think about it or switch the default to decide on it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist replaces postponement language with a choice

exampleSpecs.audience: planners who defer choices believing they can return calmly
exampleSpecs.stakes: defer once more or resolve the aging calls now
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist sees deferred decisions go stale and get rushed

exampleSpecs.audience: founders who expect waiting to reveal the answer
exampleSpecs.stakes: wait for certainty to arrive or make a call that produces evidence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist learns time alone does not generate clarity

exampleSpecs.audience: leads watching team energy fade on a long build
exampleSpecs.stakes: hoard decisions for quality or make frequent visible calls
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist links frequent decisions to visible morale

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders confusing decisiveness with irreversible bravado
exampleSpecs.stakes: make a reckless irreversible bet or a scoped revisable call
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist scopes the call instead of betting big to look bold

exampleSpecs.audience: small teams carrying unresolved choices too long
exampleSpecs.stakes: let choices float like a big org can or resolve them to keep moving
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist sees a small team cannot absorb stalled decisions
